name: Royal Mail's Address Shapes
description: Each combination of the parts of Royal Mail's Postcode Address File that Royal Mail shows in its addressing guidance: an organisation with only a dependent locality; a number with a double dependent locality; a number with a dependent thoroughfare and a thoroughfare; a building's name with a dependent locality; a building's name with a numbered thoroughfare and a locality; a numbered building's name with a thoroughfare; a part of a building; and an organisation with a dependent thoroughfare. Every address is original, written in the shape of Royal Mail's examples (through the UPU's addressing sheet for the United Kingdom); nothing copied.
